data_boundary.candidate_source: mean calibrated repeated OOF probabilities from Stage1_Train only
data_boundary.original_angle_source: previous depth-one exact-statevector XY-QAOA fit, seed 11; circuit convention verified in unit tests

readout_mitigation.method: per-qubit Aer readout-only prepared-state assignment calibration, tensor-product matrix inversion and simplex projection

noise_profile.name: illustrative_10q_line_repeated_v1
noise_profile.measurement_relaxation_model: thermal relaxation on an id gate lasting measurement_duration_seconds, followed by classical assignment error

limitations: The provisional OOF pool has all 210 exact-six selections feasible, so resource feasibility cannot be evaluated on this candidate pool.
Angle fit is reused from the earlier exact-sector development result; the present circuit-level resource and noise results are newly executed.
The ten-qubit noise profile repeats assumed seven-qubit parameters for qubits 7-9; it is a declared synthetic assumption, not device calibration.
The original phase oracle and mixer are compiled to a line, with substantial routing/state-preparation overhead; this is a simulator feasibility run, not an efficient hardware circuit.
